# Design

This plugin groups related workflows under one installation. Open the matching
contract before acting; do not answer from this index alone.

- [Design System](../../references/modules/design-system.md)
  Consume, author, normalize, migrate, and audit DESIGN.md visual contracts with exact source evidence, semantic mapping, provenance, and executable QA. Use when a project has DESIGN.md, brand evidence must become rules, or an AzSkills surface needs contract validation.
- [Ui Design](../../references/modules/ui-design.md)
  Design, build, refine, review, and animate production interfaces with one visual thesis, a token-based system, complete states, responsive behavior, accessibility, purposeful motion, and rendered visual QA. Use for web apps, dashboards, tools, settings, forms, and component libraries.
- [Style Presets](../../references/modules/style-presets.md)
  Resolve a named visual style, a style keyword, or a loading indicator to one maintained AzSkills preset, then apply it through owned tokens. Use for style-name requests, BioRender-derived direction, loader and progress states, and preset audits.

Load only the supporting references the task needs. The plugin is self-contained;
do not look for a shared AzSkills entry or for other plugins in the catalog.
